_comment: Named world-sound channels (see include/Ambience.h). Scenes start them by name (the `sound` step); the flag bus does the rest: stop_on_flag fades a loop out the moment that flag exists, start_on_flag fires a sound (once per walk) the moment its flag appears. Nothing here auto-stops on waking: the alarm and TV ring/murmur until their own deeds set alarm_off / tv_off -- leaving them on is a choice the room remembers. Standards: 22050 Hz mono ogg, peak-normalized to -1 dBFS. knock.ogg is an AWAITED ASSET.
